The Indian Air Force’s IL-76MD ‘Gajraj’ has created aviation history with a landing at 13,629 feet in Ladakh. The aircraft achieved the world’s highest-altitude landing for an IL-76MD, according to the IAF. The landing took place at Nyoma Airbase, just around 25 km from the LAC with China.
The high-altitude operation highlights the IAF’s growing strategic airlift and rapid mobilisation capability.
Here’s why the historic landing at Nyoma is strategically important for India.
